scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Congratulation! Celebrate Feast Day Of Ramadan Idul Fitri 1427 H.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
節日快樂！一起慶祝伊斯蘭曆1427年的開齋節吧！

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Haii......^FF8800{0}^000000!!
First day of Idul Fitri has arrived.
Congratulation celebrate him.
There is event special today.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
嗨...^FF8800{0}^000000！！
開齋節的第一天到了，祝你節日快樂！
今天還有特別活動。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Event today.....^009500Idul Fitri Quest!^000000
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
今天的活動是...^009500開齋節任務！^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
If you interest to follow this event, I will cook it to you.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
如果你有興趣參加，我就為你做一道美食。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I have something that might interest you.
I need all of the following items:
^D5A500Ketupat Sayur Ingredient :^000000
^00B6FF~5 Ketupat, 5 Carrot~,^000000
^CC6633~5 Sweet Potato, 10 Meat~,^000000
^000088~2 Green Herb, 5 Stem~.^000000
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
我準備了一樣你可能會感興趣的東西。
需要以下所有材料：
^D5A500蔬菜椰葉粽的材料：^000000
^00B6FF~5個椰葉粽、5根胡蘿蔔~，^000000
^CC6633~5個紅薯、10塊肉~，^000000
^000088~2株綠色藥草、5根莖~。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
You don't have enough items.
Come back when you have them all.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
您的物品不足。
集齊後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I see you already have all the items you need.
Just a moment, please!!
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
看來您已經集齊了所有需要的物品。
請稍等！！

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
We appreciate your participation in this special event.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
感謝您參加這個特別活動。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Oh well, maybe you will participate in tommorow's quest.
scripts.translation:
[開齋節職員]
好吧，那就明天再來參加任務吧。
